route: route 1/7 (age gradient, 6-permutation fit) + route 1 (endorsement mean/SD marker) + route 8 (emotion-criterion marker); cross-sample replication against the CPC-12's own development samples
evidence: Verification data is the study's own OSF deposit (1,010 complete SAE_1..SAE_3 triples, exactly the live table's per-item n of 1,010) plus the CPC-12's two development samples (Lorenz 2016 S2 Dataset n=321, S3 Dataset n=202), where the three self-efficacy items are individually identified as CPC items 10/11/12 = GSE4/GSE10/GSE6. Route 1/7 (age gradient, scored over all six permutations): S3 gives r(item,age) = .160 / .013 / .068 for items 10/11/12; the French data gives r(SAE_1,Age)=.171, r(SAE_2,Age)=-.032, r(SAE_3,Age)=.100 at wave 0 (n=674) and .154 / -.058 / .090 at wave 5 (n=336). The shipped permutation is the best-fitting of the six at both waves, with SSE .0031 against a runner-up .0161 (wave 0) and .0055 against .0172 (wave 5). Route 1 (endorsement marker): item 11 is the highest-mean, lowest-SD item in BOTH German samples (S2 means 3.738/4.271/4.059, SDs .929/.749/.880; S3 means 3.847/4.332/4.223, SDs .823/.775/.938) and SAE_2 is the highest-mean, lowest-SD French item (means 5.379/5.561/5.373, SDs 1.207/1.060/1.234). Route 8 (semantic/criterion marker): item 12 is the emotionally loaded item, correlating .294 with life satisfaction in S3 against .092 and .114, and -.401 with neuroticism against -.270 and -.221; SAE_3 is correspondingly the strongest correlate of Pellerin's well-being scales in 6 of 6 wave x criterion comparisons (wave 0 EWB .279/.286/.373, SWB .278/.237/.333, IWB .372/.296/.472; wave 5 EWB .359/.377/.384, SWB .320/.288/.335, IWB .345/.315/.424). WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: no file anywhere states the SAE_k <-> item-(9+k) correspondence, so this is a structural match rather than a source-level label tie, and it assumes the German development samples' item structure carries to a French translation administered on a 1-7 rather than a 1-6 scale. One statistic actively dissents: both German samples make {item 11, item 12} the MOST correlated within-block pair (.559 in S2, .486 in S3) while the French data makes {SAE_2, SAE_3} the LEAST correlated pair (.525, against .641 and .588). The only remap that would repair that places item 10 at SAE_2, which the age and endorsement routes both refuse, so the shipped mapping stands - but because a fourth route contradicts, this is PARTIAL and not VERIFIED. See verify_pellerin2020_cpc_selfefficacy.R (VERDICT: PASS).

route: route 3 (deposit's own derived scale total: unique reverse-key subset) + route 6 (keying polarity) + route 1 (published loading ordering)
evidence: Route 3 (subscale/scale total, decisive for the reverse pair) + route 6 (keying polarity) + route 1 (published loadings, ordinal). (A) The OSF deposit carries the authors' own derived scale score Grat.world. Over the 674 wave-0 respondents with a complete GQ_1..GQ_6, the 6-item mean with exactly columns 3 and 6 reversed reproduces it to max abs deviation 3.553e-15; all 64 reversal subsets were tried and the next-best is 1.1667 (subsets {3}, {6}, {1,3,6}, {2,3,6}), so {GQ_3,GQ_6} is the unique reverse pair (1 in 64 by chance). The canonical GQ-6 reverses items 3 and 6, which sit at exactly those positions. (B) On the live IRW table (n=1,010 person-waves with all six items) GQ_3 and GQ_6 are the only two items with a negative mean correlation to the others (raw alpha 0.14, rising to 0.81 once those two are keyed; the authors' own alpha(...,check.keys=TRUE) on their analysed wave-0 subsample returns 0.79, the value the article prints). Keyed first-PC loadings are GQ_2 0.875, GQ_1 0.850, GQ_4 0.742, GQ_3 0.716, GQ_5 0.650, GQ_6 0.436: the weakest is GQ_6, matching item 6's documented weakness (.079 Chilean adult EFA PMC4815209 Table 1; 0.29 German validation PMC7586006; .52 Brazilian; it is the item removed to form the GQ-5), and the two strongest are GQ_1 and GQ_2, matching items 1 and 2 as the top-loading near-synonymous pair (.838/.812 Chilean). WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: GQ_1 vs GQ_2, and GQ_4 vs GQ_5. Both routes act on blocks; no published per-item statistic orders those pairs reproducibly - the Chilean EFA ranks item 5 (.749) above item 4 (.701) while the live data ranks them 0.650 vs 0.742, and the 'As I get older' item shows no distinguishing age gradient (partial r with age controlling the scale total: GQ_5 +0.022, GQ_2 +0.026, GQ_1 -0.062, GQ_4 -0.032, n=674). Those two within-block orderings rest on the deposit's columns being numbered in the instrument's own order. Hence PARTIAL.
